summary: Enterprise rate limiting and abuse protection were implemented for sensitive backend surfaces, including fail-closed production behavior for high-risk policies, hashed IP key material, standard response headers, and redacted audit metadata.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.
controlsVerified: High-risk production policies fail closed when Redis is missing or unavailable.
Low-risk health/internal and general-api policies degrade according to explicit policy.
Legacy sensitive keys infer fail-closed enterprise categories through the compatibility wrapper.
Uncategorized direct server limiter calls default to the fail-closed auth policy.
Limiter keys use hashed IP material and avoid raw client IP disclosure.
Rate-limit audit events store keyHash instead of raw limiter keys.
Blocked responses emit Retry-After, RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, and RateLimit-Reset headers.

runtime.productionStore: Upstash Redis REST pipeline using INCR, EXPIRE NX and TTL
runtime.lowRiskProductionFailureMode: policy based fail-open for health/internal and general-api
runtime.pipelineResponseParsing: accepts object-style REST result fields and tuple-style result entries

notes: This evidence file follows the P0 runtime evidence hygiene schema and contains no secret values.
Follow-up work can migrate the route-local step-up challenge deny response to the shared rateLimitResponse helper, but the limiter policy is already applied.
